name: Sione Haugen
location: Pilsen Veil â€” performs at the junction of Menomonee Gulch and Mexicantown Libre, near Halsted and Division
description:
Sione Haugen is old in the way the city makes people old â€” not withered but compacted, all the softness burned away until what remains is extremely dense. He is dark-skinned, Congolese and Russian heritage visible in the breadth of his face and his pale grey eyes, which are startling and which he has never modified because he believes his body came to him as a message he is still decoding. He wears the same long coat in all seasons, patched so many times it has become a map of itself, and he carries a battered audio-capture pendant around his neck that predates most of the people he performs for. He smells of coffee and the particular chemical tang of Pilsen Veil's air.

He stands at his corner three or four days a week and recites â€” original poems, memorized classics from a dozen traditions, improvised responses to whatever is happening that day in the Veil. He does not pass a hat. He does not have an uplink for transfers. He accepts food, sometimes. He has been doing this for thirty-one years, through two corporate rezoning attempts, a flood event, a plague year, and a period when Ferrogate Transit security actively moved him on weekly. He came back each time. He is not sentimental about this â€” he describes it as a job, and himself as a worker.

core_fears: dying with things unsaid that matter
that his presence has been more comfort than challenge â€” that he soothed people when he should have unsettled them
core_desires: one person who hears something in his work and changes because of it
coping_mechanisms: the practice of the work itself â€” showing up is the coping mechanism
treats E.L.F.s with the respectful skepticism he treats all authorities
blind_spots: believes his detachment from material life is wisdom when sometimes it is avoidance
his refusal to be digitally present means younger people can't find his work or build on it
psychology.secret: Thirty years ago he was involved in the organized resistance to Ferrogate Transit's first rezoning of Pilsen Veil â€” not as a poet but as someone who helped plan direct action that caused significant property damage. A young transit worker was injured. Ghislain never knew if the man recovered. He has never spoken of this and it lives in his work in a way he believes no one notices, though some do.

speech_patterns.vocabulary: Precise and elevated but never academic â€” he can switch registers instantly and does so deliberately. Quotes from memory in Lingala, Russian, Spanish, and Standard Meridian. When performing, he uses silence as punctuation.
speech_patterns.cadence: Slow and weighted when performing. In conversation: quicker, drier, with unexpected humor.
verbal_tics: long pauses before answering questions â€” he is actually thinking
'Is that what happened?' (genuine question, not rhetorical)
example_lines: 'The Veil has been erased four times. I have watched it erase itself and return. The city thinks it is doing the erasing. The city is mistaken.'
'I am not a symbol. Symbols are convenient. I am a man who comes to this corner because no one has successfully stopped me yet.'

story_hooks: He has a poem he has never performed â€” written thirty years ago the night after the Ferrogate incident â€” that contains the names of everyone involved. He is considering performing it before he dies, and he knows it would have consequences.

A corporate cultural archivist from Palladian has been approaching him for months about 'preserving his legacy' â€” the offer is genuine but the contract would give Palladian rights to his entire oral archive, including thirty years of recorded performances he doesn't know they've been making from public space.
narrative_function: Lore and history source â€” has witnessed thirty years of the Veil's changes and remembers names, dates, and the texture of events; moral voice in stories; the person characters go to when they need perspective rather than information; the ghost that makes a place feel real.
augmentations: None. Categorically refuses all modifications on grounds he describes differently each time he is asked.
daily_life: Wakes at dawn, walks from his single-room Pilsen Veil flat to his corner, sits and reads until mid-morning, performs through the afternoon, accepts whatever conversation comes his way, walks home at dusk. Cooks his own food. Does not own a working screen.
affiliation: Independent; recognized by the Mexicantown Libre community assembly as a cultural heritage figure (unofficial designation); UBC recipient

decision_rules: will not perform for private audiences â€” the work is for the street
will not accept money from corporate entities under any framing
escalation_ladder: the poem that addresses exactly the situation he's in (devastating and specific)
leaves â€” simply walks away, unhurriedly, without drama

interpersonal_modes.strangers: treats them as potentially interesting â€” listens more than he speaks
interpersonal_modes.friends: bone-dry humor, enormous patience, will tell you the truth you don't want to hear eventually

stress_responses.low: works on the problem in verse
stress_responses.medium: becomes very still and very polite
stress_responses.high: goes silent for days, then emerges with something he has to say

contradictions: preaches presence and witness while carrying a secret that he has never witnessed aloud in thirty years
habits: greets the E.L.F. that inhabits the streetlight at his corner each morning â€” one tap for hello
breaking_points: someone claiming ownership of public space through cultural erasure
being told his work has 'historical value' in a way that means it no longer matters now

physical_description.heritage: A complex genetic tapestry of Southeast Asian (33.3%), Pacific Islander (26.7%), and South Asian (17.2%) predominance, interwoven with Hispanic/Latin American (10.5%), Northern European (6.5%), and Sub-Saharan African (5.8%) ancestryâ€”the living embodiment of the Ubiquitous Diaspora. Sione's phenotype defies singular regional classification: warm caramel-bronze skin with golden undertones carries Southeast Asian and Pacific Islander melanin depth, enriched by South Asian luminosity and subtle Sub-Saharan warmth. Bone structure reflects this blendâ€”Southeast Asian and Pacific Islander angularity softened by South Asian prominence in the nose and jaw, with Northern European ancestry visible only in pale eye color and subtle facial proportions.
physical_description.build: Lean and densely muscled, the kind of thinness that comes from decades of sparse living rather than youth â€” all remaining mass is functional, no softness. Shoulders still broad but slightly rounded forward from age and posture. Hands show the tremor of old age but retain deliberate strength.
physical_description.skin_tone: Burnished caramel-bronze with rich golden-warm undertonesâ€”Southeast Asian and Pacific Islander melanin base deepened by South Asian luminosity, weathered by decades of industrial air exposure into a lived-in patina that reads as vital and grounded rather than faded.
physical_description.complexion: Deeply lined face, particularly around the eyes and mouthâ€”evidence of decades of outdoor performance and expression. High, prominent cheekbones reflecting Southeast Asian and Pacific Islander structure, with subtle but distinct South Asian prominence in the nose bridge and jawline definition. Bone structure shows balanced proportions from mixed ancestry. Clean-shaven except for grey stubble appearing within hours. Skin has weathered texture but remains unbroken and vital, with permanent creases from smiling radiating from eye corners and mouth.
distinguishing_marks: Long thin scar running from left temple to jaw, pale and old, origin unknown to casual observers
Calluses on the palms and fingertips of both hands, deep and permanent
Small burn mark on the inside of his left wrist, circular, approximately 2cm diameter, deliberately positioned where a watch would be
Faint tattoo on the inside of his right forearm â€” Cyrillic characters, faded to near-invisibility, possibly a date
physical_description.visible_augmentations: None. The audio-capture pendant around his neck is ancient non-networked technology, visibly pre-2190s, with a worn leather cord and dented brass casing â€” this is a tool, not an augmentation.
physical_description.posture_movement: Stands with weight distributed evenly, rooted â€” a performer's stance. Moves with deliberate economy, no wasted gesture. When performing, his hands become expressive and fluid despite their age. When listening, his entire body tilts slightly toward the speaker. Walks slowly but with purpose, following the same routes daily.
physical_description.clothing_style: One long coat, charcoal grey wool, heavily patched with fabric of different origins â€” some synthetic, some organic, some metallic â€” creating a visible patchwork across the back and sleeves. Beneath it: simple grey or brown cotton shirts, worn thin. Black utility pants, multiple pockets, frayed at the cuffs. Boots resoled multiple times, held together with intention. The overall effect is Tier 5 by necessity but Tier 1 in maintenance and dignity â€” nothing is discarded, everything is maintained. No jewelry except the pendant. No visible brand markers. Clothing smells of coffee grounds, smoke, and the metallic-chemical tang of industrial runoff.
